top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Başkent's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Başkent. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 56 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
56 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
72ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Gran Fondo Başkent, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Gran Fondo Başkent. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Başkent. Train it until it feels boring.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Başkent. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,058ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Gran Fondo Başkent's 56 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Gran Fondo Başkent. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Gran Fondo Başkent rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 56 miles of mixed terrain in Ankara, Turkey.
